department: Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering

deadline.value: PhD applications for Fall 2027 are due December 1, 2026.
deadline.quote: The PhD application deadline for Fall 2027 is December 1, 2026, at 11:59 p.m.

gre_general.value: GRE General is not required for PhD applications.
gre_general.quote: The Whiting School of Engineering does not require GRE General Test scores for applications to our master’s and PhD programs.

toefl_min.value: The department requires TOEFL iBT 100 from international applicants (enforced in most cases).
toefl_min.quote: A TOEFL score of 100 is required for international applicants from non-English speaking countries.

ielts_min.value: The department requires IELTS 7.0 for applicants whose native language is not English.
ielts_min.quote: A minimum IELTS score of 7.0 is required for applicants whose native language is not English.

english_waiver.value: Whiting School of Engineering sets the English-test waiver rule and the page listing it could not be fetched, so the Krieger rule is not shown for Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering.

supervisor.value: You need not contact professors; you may state your interest in the application.
supervisor.quote: There is no need for you to individually contact professors during the admissions process.

funding.value: The page says aid packages include tuition and stipend but not that every admitted student is funded.

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether a master's is expected.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study
